decision.explanation: The question asks when the City of Maryborough was established. Document D1S2 explicitly states that the City of Maryborough existed as a local government entity from 1861 until 2008. Additionally, D2S1 and D2S2 both reference events in 1861 tied to the development of the area, supporting the establishment year. The original cards and audits confirm this as the direct and consistent answer.
